name: @dh-multiagents/bundle

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e 'const ua = process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ""; if (ua.indexOf("pnpm") !== 0) { console.error("@dh-multiagents/bundle: publish with pnpm only — plain npm publish ships workspace:* deps unresolved (broke 0.1.0). Run: pnpm publish"); process.exit(1) }'
